title: Edge labels in one part
statement: Let $q$, $k$, and $n$ be natural numbers, let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$, and assign an $n$-valued label to each edge of the matching. For a part $i$, the set of labels on the matching edges selected at the vertices in that part consists of the labels obtained at every position among the $k$ positions.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers q, k, and n
A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with q parts of size k
An assignment of an n-valued label to each matching edge
A part i among q parts
